refresh: Anonymous raw GitHub document fetch only; identical to prior funding increment source. No signed private endpoint called.

implemented.nonce: Server milliseconds x 1000, shared monotonic microsecond counter with Spot/Futures account requests.
implemented.signing: Document requires master-associated signer. Current implementation tries only connected EOA as both user and signer, as in existing account requests. Acceptance unproven; authorization failures surfaced, never bypassed by creating an agent wallet.
ui: Explicit read/refresh only; no automatic signature
Names, copyable exact IDs, parent/subaccount labels, count, search
Initial/empty/parent-only, busy/stop waiting, failure with retained stale snapshot, retry
Directory auto-disposed on exit; no persisted list or local active-account selection
implemented.creation_limit: PRD max ten children is a creation rule. List preserves existing rows above ten; no child is silently dropped.

remaining_subaccount_requirements.create: Requires independently controlled child wallet address, childSignature over first message, then master signature including childSignature. POST returns code/msg, not an address/private key. Child custody choice pending user preference; no new wallet generated.
remaining_subaccount_requirements.switch: List lacks child address, accountId-to-wallet mapping and switching authorization. Do not invent accountId transport parameter, label a row active, or replace signer based on a name.
remaining_subaccount_requirements.freeze_update: POST updateSubAccount requires subSourceAddr and master signature; list provides no address or state for preflight/final verification. No freeze/unfreeze POST exposed yet.
remaining_subaccount_requirements.frozen_scope: Document blocks cross-account transfers to/from frozen children; does not establish that orders, cancellation, TP/SL, existing tasks or internal Spot/Futures transfers stop.
remaining_subaccount_requirements.cross_account_transfer: Requires verified wallet relationship, source/destination addresses, allowance and result reconciliation. Not implemented.
remaining_subaccount_requirements.enable_trading: RegisterAndApproveAgent is agent registration with distinct protocol chainId=signatureChainId (56 for EVM) and ten-second nonce freshness. Not interchangeable with chain1666 account signatures or Privy SIWE. Self-agent authorization and compatible no-extra-wallet flow remain unproven; no approval submission was exposed or sent.

security_boundaries: No wallet generation, raw private key, secret persistence, financial request or account switch.
Redirects disabled; signed URL never forwarded or logged. Rejected signing and scope loss prevent send.
Auth observer now includes walletKind changes, so same-address signing-mode changes reset dependent snapshots.
Stopping only stops waiting and invalidates this operation; does not claim a wallet prompt was dismissed.
List and asset-index controllers watch auto-disposed repositories, retaining clients through pending operations and disposing them with the last consumer.
